target.title: fix(sms): normalize Twilio RCS addresses
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Twilio RCS messages can arrive with `From=rcs:+E164`. The native SMS channel already owns Twilio Messaging Service delivery, but its phone normalizer only stripped `sms:` / `twilio-sms:` prefixes. That can leave RCS-form senders malformed for SMS-owned flows, which breaks allowlist matching, canonical direct-session routing, and reply targeting.

This PR makes the existing SMS path understand Twilio's `rcs:+E164` address form without claiming broad first-class RCS support.

## Implementation

The scope is intentionally narrow:

- normalize `rcs:` prefixes inside SMS-owned phone parsing
- route `rcs:+E164` inbound/session targets to the existing canonical `sms:direct:+E164` session
- reply back through the existing Twilio SMS send path with a canonical E.164 `to`
- do **not** register SMS as a global `rcs:` channel target prefix or add a broad RCS channel

## User Impact

Twilio Messaging Service RCS inbound events can participate in the same SMS direct-session flow as SMS/MMS without producing malformed phone numbers or reply targets. This is useful for RCS-on-Twilio setups while preserving room for a future first-class RCS channel.

## Evidence

Validation run on branch head `07bcb0698b`:

- `git diff --check`
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check extensions/sms/src/inbound.test.ts extensions/sms/src/phone.test.ts extensions/sms/src/phone.ts extensions/sms/src/session-route.test.ts`
- `OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 OPENCLAW_VITEST_FS_MODULE_CACHE_PATH=/tmp/oc-vitest-sms-rcs-phone node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/sms/src/phone.test.ts extensions/sms/src/session-route.test.ts extensions/sms/src/inbound.test.ts --reporter=verbose` — 3 files / 8 tests passed
- `OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 OPENCLAW_VITEST_FS_MODULE_CACHE_PATH=/tmp/oc-vitest-sms-rcs-full node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/sms/src/phone.test.ts extensions/sms/src/accounts.test.ts extensions/sms/src/gateway.test.ts extensions/sms/src/webhook.test.ts extensions/sms/src/inbound.test.ts extensions/sms/src/status.test.ts extensions/sms/src/twilio.test.ts extensions/sms/src/channel.test.ts extensions/sms/src/session-route.test.ts extensions/sms/src/secret-contract.test.ts extensions/sms/src/send.test.ts --reporter=verbose` — 11 files / 65 tests passed

## Real behavior proof

No live Twilio/Gateway mutation was performed for this PR. The change is covered with local regression tests for parsing, allowlist/session routing, context construction, and reply delivery. Earlier Twilio test-device work identified this exact `rcs:+E164` inbound shape; this PR is the narrow code fix for that observed normalization/reply-routing gap. Live RCS transport proof can be added separately if maintainers want an exact Twilio transcript before merge.
